[[File:Greyling 0S.png|thumb|A [[greyling]], an aggressive creature found in the [[Meadows]].]] '''Creatures''' are non-player characters which are found throughout ''[[Valheim (world)|Valheim]]''. They can be split to four categories: * [[Creatures#Bosses|Bosses]] are powerful aggressive creatures that must be summoned. Killing them unlocks [[Forsaken power|Forsaken powers]], increases [[Global Keys|world difficulty]] and provides loot to progress in the game. * [[Creatures#Minibosses|Minibosses]] are unique, named, aggressive creatures that you can find in specific dungeons. Killing any given miniboss will reward with one of [[Hildir's Chests]]. * [[Creatures#Aggressive creatures|Aggressive creatures]] will attack players when alerted. They also drop loot when killed. * [[Creatures#Passive creatures|Passive creatures]] provide resources when killed (or harvested). They will never attack players. * [[Creatures#NPCs|NPCs]] are friendly creatures/characters that cannot be killed and may provide some service or help to the player. == Bosses == Bosses, also known as the '''Forsaken''', can be summoned by offering specific items (hinted by the [[Runestone#Altar Runestones|Runestones]]) at their specific spawn site. They have increased HP and special attacks compared to regular creatures. A boss site is automatically marked on the player's map by reading the runestone in the specific biomes. There are multiple spawn locations for every boss. '''Behavior''' *Creatures will give up chasing after unable to attack for 60 seconds or unable to detect the target for 30 seconds. *Some creatures have a max chase range. After chasing that far they will give up if unable to detect the target for 1 seconds. *After unable to attack for 15 seconds, creatures will focus structures for 15 seconds if they can't reach the target. *Creatures only attack walls and doors if they aren't able to reach the target player. *Some creatures are afraid of fire and will flee from it. *Some creatures try to avoid fire and will be passive near it. *Some creatures circulate around the target while waiting to attack. *Swimming creatures try to flee towards water if forced on ground. *Creatures passively regenerate 1.67% of their max health every minute (100% over 60 minutes). *Creatures gain +30% more effective health per each additional player within 100 meters. E.g. 3 players = +60% effective health. **This is updated whenever the creature takes damage. *Creatures gain +4% more damage per each additional player within 100 meters. There, it can be mined from [[Muddy Scrap Pile]]s using any pickaxe, or found inside [[Chest]]s. The [[Swamp Key]], obtained from the [[Elder]], has to be obtained to access Sunken Crypts. Alternatively, Muddy scrap piles can be found underground in Swamps. However, these are scarce, and ultimately yield little Iron scrap. They can be located using a [[Wishbone]] or by using the [[How to play#How_to_prospect_properly?|Prospecting]] method with a [[Stagbreaker]] or Weapons with the same attack ([[Iron Sledge]]). [[Oozer]]s can also rarely drop Scrap iron with a drop rate of around 30%. Later in the game, Iron and [[Copper Scrap]] can be obtained by mining [[Ancient Sword]]s and [[Ancient Armor]] in the [[Mistlands]]. == Notes == * Like other metals, Scrap Iron cannot be teleported without a [[Portal stone]]. * Scrap iron ore is 2 units lighter than smelted Iron. {{MaterialsNav}} [[ru:Металлолом]] [[cs:Železný šrot]] [[uk:Металобрухт]] [[de:Eisenschrott]] [[fr:Ferraille]]

'''Chain lightning''' is an on-hit effect triggered by weapons upgraded with [[Iolite]] or [[Thunderblood Essence]].

==Effect==
Chain lightning has a 25% chance to trigger on a normal attack and a 20% chance to trigger on a secondary attack.

It deals 75 [[lightning]] damage to the target, the amount is not affected by skills, and it cannot be blocked or dodged.

Once triggered, it has an 80% chance of bouncing off nearby enemies or players. If so, each nearby target within 8 meters has a 30% chance of being targeted, up to a maximum of 2–4 targets per bounce (the maximum is chosen at random then targets are processed starting from the nearest). The process repeats indefinitely, centered on each new target, but with the chance of rebound multiplied by 0.75 each time (i.e., 80% → 60% → 45% → 33.75%, etc.).

A single activation of chain lightning cannot affect the same target more than once.

==Notes==
* Chain lightning within the vicinity of neutral [[Ashlands Dvergr]] has the potential of damaging them, immediately turning them hostile.

'''Frigid Kiln''' is a structure used to produce {{Item link|Liquid Frost}} out of {{Item link|Ice}}. Liquid Frost is the fuel of the [[Frost Foundry]].

==Availability==
* {{Item link|Frostcore}} can be obtained from [[Winding Tunnels]].
* {{Item link|Ice}} can be obtained by mining [[Ice Sheet]]s on the shore of the [[Deep North]], or dropped from [[Greydwarf (Deep North)|Greydwarfs]] in the Deep North

==Building==
The Frigid Kiln is found in the Crafting category of the [[Hammer]] and requires a nearby [[Workbench]] to build. It cannot be placed on wood, in water or on sloped surfaces. It costs:
* {{Item link|Stone|20}}
* {{Item link|Frostcore|10}}
* {{Item link|Ice|5}}

It has 1,500 durability. It is resistant to blunt, pierce, slash and chop damage, and immune to fire, frost, poison and spirit damage.

==Usage==
Ice is the kiln's only input; it is added like fuel, and no other item is needed. The kiln holds up to 25 [[Ice]] at a time. It produces one [[Liquid Frost]] every 30 seconds by consuming five Ice, so a full load of 25 Ice becomes five Liquid Frost in 150 seconds. Each Liquid Frost is ejected as soon as it is made.

Like the [[Smelter]], the Frigid Kiln stops working while its smoke is blocked.
